claim: Adds PDE residual and boundary constraint training to a DeepONet solution-operator model.
claim_zh: 在DeepONet训练目标中增加物理残差与边界约束。
innovation_detail: Augment the DeepONet training objective with physical residual and boundary constraints.
innovation_detail_zh: 在DeepONet训练目标中增加物理残差与边界约束。
bottleneck: Paired high-fidelity solution samples may be costly for training parametric PDE solution operators.
bottleneck_zh: 参数化PDE算子训练所需的高精度配对解场成本较高。
tradeoff: Requires appropriate physics formulation and training weight choices.
